scope.requirement_transcribed: apply each venue's VIP-0 fees, funding at 1h/8h, without double counting spread, expecting a positive net return at 2.0x fees
scope.prior_cost_basis: a flat 6.0 bps per unit of turnover on every hypothesis; each reconciliation block shows the new model reproducing that charge exactly when driven by fees alone

venue_fees.source: audit section 14.1, VIP-0 fee table, October-November 2026
venue_fees.side_note: maker fills are refused rather than defaulted: this lab scores books on daily closes with no queue position, so a maker assumption has nothing behind it

notes.bybit: perp 0.020/0.055 — 0.5 bps dearer than Binance on the taker side; Innovation Zone 0.200/0.200 not applied

spread_band.method: Corwin-Schultz on per-symbol 4-hour bars, median of per-bar estimates, sign kept; 4-hour bars rather than daily because a daily high-low range is dominated by the day's trend rather than by the quoted spread
spread_band.caveat: A high-low estimator measures the range the price covered, and only part of that range is the bid-ask. For a liquid pair the true quoted spread is a few bps, while this estimator reads tens of bps on the same bars, so the estimate is an upper bound rather than a calibration. It is used as the top of a band whose floor is the audit's own liquid-pair half-spread anchor; the band's width is reported rather than hidden behind a single point estimate.

cost_model.no_double_counting: the audit's rule has two branches and the close-price branch binds here: there is no book and no fill, so half spread, latency slippage and volatility-dependent impact are added explicitly to the crossed price rather than assumed to be inside it
cost_model.notional_convention: traded notional is the signed difference |w_t - w_t-1| per leg, which is already per side, so a round trip appears as two units and is charged twice without the model doubling anything; H3's two legs each carry half the pair weight, so its two charges sum to one unit of pair notional per rebalance and its baseline is 12.0 bps per rebalance, not 6.0

assumptions.note: the impact coefficient is the square-root law's slope; 1.0 is the conservative upper end quoted for crypto pairs, and the 2.0x/3.0x rungs are what test the answer against it being wrong

market_state.note: both statistics are trailing and shifted one day, so an impact estimate never reads the volume or volatility of the day it prices

execution_spec.order: one perp leg at full book weight

reconciliation.note: funding is the cash flow each strategy already books, recomputed from the position and funding panels independently; it is reported, not charged again

methodology.verdict_rule: G6 passes for a hypothesis only if net expectancy per trade stays positive at 2.0x fees at BOTH ends of the spread band on both full sample and post-embargo locked_oos; the audit's ladder does not stop at 2.0x, so the full path is reported too
methodology.superseded_basis: G5's verdicts were computed on the flat-6bps book. G6's ladder starts at the realistic schedule, so a hypothesis can pass one gate and fail the other; where that happens both verdicts are reported and neither is overridden
not_implemented: FIFO L2 queue-position calibration against HftBacktest (the audit's HIGH (P1) blocker: the paper simulator has never been calibrated)
accounting reconciliation against NautilusTrader v2.0.0rc9 trade by trade, and the <1 bps day-30 promotion criterion that depends on it

Hyperliquid 1h funding: all four normalized datasets are Binance Vision, so the hourly cadence is transcribed and compared but not simulated; the planned Binance + Hyperliquid cross-check was not realised

per-symbol rather than single-value half spread: a 24 bps half spread is not a credible quote for a major pair, so the estimate is carried as an upper bound and the band width is reported in place of a point estimate
cross-venue spread and impact: spread and volatility come from Binance bars, so the venue comparison covers fees only
operation cost allocation (founder time under 10 h/week is a constraint in the audit, not a per-trade charge) and borrow cost on the spot leg
regime-conditional cost stress: costs are stressed across the whole sample, not per market regime
